description:

Fill it OPAQUE in ONLY neutral equal-RGB GRAYSCALE matching its surrounding armor or dark undercloth; use the gray swatch reference. Selected transparent holes inside native body become dark cloth/plate, never empty background. Do not erase or move any original opaque pixel.
All existing helmet, rune breastplate, dark short tabard, belt, bracers, trousers, boots, materials and silhouette remain the SAME. No new styling or redesign. Native faces/hands/limb/foot contours are unmasked and immutable. No new face, hands, skin, colored cloth, text or objects. NORTH stays back with no face/front rune.
